_note: Strings kept in English on purpose, each with a reason group. build-pack.mjs skips these keys, so Orca shows the source text, and does not count them as missing.

groups.proper-name: Names of products, services, agents, models, programming languages, alert sounds and templates
groups.tech-term: Terms kept in English by docs/glossary.md: PR, MR, issue, CLI, token, terminal, worktree, Stage, Rebase and similar
groups.url-path-example: URLs, paths, domains, branch names and sample data
groups.format-only: Only placeholders, numbers, units or symbols, nothing to translate
groups.search-keyword: Settings search keywords kept so the English word still finds the setting
groups.code-command: Commands, environment variables, CSS selectors and key names
